title: Definitions.
bodyText:
[PART VIII.] MARK LICENSING AGREEMENT PROGRAM

As used in this part, "mark" means any trademark or service mark entitled to registration under chapter 482, whether registered or not.
bodyHtml:
[PART VIII.]  MARK LICENSING AGREEMENT PROGRAM

 

     [§302A-1901]  Definitions.  As used in this part, "mark" means any trademark or service mark entitled to registration under chapter 482, whether registered or not. [L 2017, c 140, pt of §1]
